review_notes: This is a coverage review assembly, not a set of fabrication-ready panel or joint files.
Purple temporary solids occupy every approved glow/light-transmitting opening.
Pale-cyan temporary eye solids use the corrected annotated silhouettes and the original eye carrier planes only for depth placement.
Opaque temporary backing panels close both rear/under-ear loops.
Opaque eye-surround rings close the original oversized eye openings so only the corrected eye shapes transmit light.
The red mouth opening and 100 x 80 mm rear service opening are the only intended large openings.
Rear ventilation and bottom drains are intentionally deferred until enclosure and joint coverage is approved.
